svg.title: Speaker poster: restore internal detail when a silhouette loses the intended information
svg.desc: Only object-tone filter changes silhouette-tone→none. The identical generated fictional maker cutout, alpha, outline, pose, image frame/fitting, position and all text/type/paper/light stay fixed. Original source color and internal detail return; no reshoot, new identity, pose change, retouching or crop change. This is an intentional exception to silhouette use. Original fictional example. Generated photographic sources; native silhouette composition and typography.
svg.text: AFTER · The portrait restores facial detail
Only the declared silhouette treatment or ground changes. Source, outline, scale, copy and presentation stay fixed.
